title: Content pack manifest
description: Envelope for a body of game content. SRD is simply the first pack; homebrew and expansions use the identical shape.

id.description: Pack namespace. Prefixes every content id this pack defines.

version.description: Semver. Campaigns pin this so an old campaign resolves the content it was built against.

attribution.description: Required for CC-BY content; surfaced in the UI.

providesEffectTypes.description: Namespaced effect types this pack introduces (`homebrew:effect/soul-burn`). The loader unions these across all loaded packs and rejects any effect whose non-core `type` was never declared. This is how a third-party pack adds mechanics without editing the shared schemas.

provides.description: Collections this pack ships. Each entry maps to <name>.json in the pack directory.
